title: A 16-Year-Old Guitar Hero From Thailand Just Won America's Got Talent!
summary:
Imagine standing on a huge stage in a new country, holding your electric guitar. Your hands are shaking. Then you start to play — and the whole crowd jumps up and cheers.

That's exactly what happened to Nene Royal. She's a 16-year-old from Thailand, and she just won America's Got Talent! She's the first person from Thailand ever to win the show. Her prize? One million dollars.

For her first audition, she played a heavy, rocking version of the song "Zombie" by the Cranberries. The video of that moment has been watched 21 million times. "I was really, really nervous," she said. "But once I started playing, I just stopped thinking about everything else."

Nene started playing guitar when she was only seven years old. She grew up in Phuket, Thailand. Her dad doesn't play music at all, but he took her to practices and cheered her on. During her big audition, you can see him in the crowd, rocking out with a big smile.

Now she has big plans. She wants to make a rock album and go on tour. But first? She's taking her band to Disneyland or Universal Studios. "Maybe the theme park," she says. "Or sleep."
why_it_matters: It shows that practicing something you love — even when your hands shake — can open big doors, and that kids from small towns far away can win on the world's biggest stages.

background_read: America's Got Talent (a TV competition in the United States where singers, dancers and other performers try to win) has turned many unknown people into stars.
Thailand (a country in Southeast Asia) has a big music scene of its own, and Thai fans get very excited when one of their musicians becomes famous around the world.
"Zombie" by the Cranberries (a rock band from Ireland) came out in the 1990s and is famous for its loud, strong, angry sound.
Article_Structure: WHO: Nene Royal, a 16-year-old guitarist from Thailand, and her dad, who drove her to practices and cheered from the crowd.
WHAT: She won America's Got Talent and the one-million-dollar prize after playing a heavy rock version of the song "Zombie".
WHERE: On the show's stage in the United States, though she grew up in Phuket, Thailand.
WHY: She has played guitar since she was seven and kept going even when she felt nervous — and now she plans a rock album, a tour and a theme-park trip with her band.

perspectives.description: They are proud that a Thai teenager became the first person from Thailand to win the show, which shows talent can come from anywhere.

perspectives.perspective: Kids who get scared on stage
perspectives.description: Nene said she was really nervous, but once she started playing she stopped thinking about everything else — proof that fear doesn't have to stop you.
They think TV talent shows often care more about dramatic stories and big moments than about real musicianship, though Nene won with nothing but her guitar.
